headline: L3Harris (LHX) Stock Looks Below Fair Value On Current Assumptions
summary: L3Harris Technologies stock has delivered a 65.7% return over the past three years, and the current Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate suggests the shares may still be trading at a 31.9% discount to that fair value. This raises the question of how much upside is already reflected in the price after this run. A 65.7% three year return puts L3Harris Technologies in focus for investors asking whether the recent share price performance has already captured much of its long term...
